room_rent.note: Room Rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day; proportionate deduction applies if higher room chosen

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day; ICU charges not subject to proportionate deduction

copayment.note: 20% co-pay on every claim; waiver available if additional premium paid

sub_limits.display: Cataract ₹40k/eye, Modern Tx 50% SI, AYUSH 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern Treatments: up to 50% of SI; AYUSH: up to 50% of SI; room rent 1% SI/day; ICU 2% SI/day

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for all illnesses except accidents; 90 days for lump-sum benefit under Section 7

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disability: 24 months; HIV/AIDS: 30-day initial waiting only; other PEDs: 48 months

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions include cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, hysterectomy, varicose veins, calculi, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of day-care procedures provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusion 11

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to 50% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of Sum Insured as inpatient or day-care

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables/non-medical items in Annexure II List I

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for yearly premium mode; 15 days for half-yearly/quarterly/monthly instalment modes

free_look.note: Free-look period of 15 days from date of receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies only

portability.note: Portability to same product of other insurers as per IRDAI guidelines; migration within company also allowed but only on product withdrawal

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, organ donor hospitalisation, domiciliary treatment, ART for HIV, prosthesis/devices for disability, STDs, stem cell storage, alternative therapies (acupuncture etc.)
